messages:
Sam: FYI — AcmeCorp legal just asked for a private VPC deployment with customer-managed HSM for prod. Sales timeline: they want go-live in ~7 weeks. Can product confirm feasibility + blockers?
Elaine: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the SOW + primary contact? Also what exactly is non-negotiable (HSM vs hosted KMS, airgap, audit cadence)? Need to triage.
Sam: SOW link (redacted): https://acme.example.com/sow. Contact: leah@acme.com. Req: customer-managed HSM (no key export), no internet egress from inference nodes, monthly audit reports. Budget approved by procurement.
Elaine: @Jordan @Priya can you weigh in quickly? High-level list I think we'll need: 1) private control plane connectivity options, 2) HSM/KMS workflow + key custody, 3) audit/log export to customer SIEM, 4) packaging for VPC/on-prem. Flag any compliance/legal blockers.
Jordan: Short answer: doable but non-trivial. Rough estimates: infra/network automation + packaging ~3 sprints; HSM integration (PKCS#11 adapter, keywrap, rotation flows) ~2 sprints. Manual run for some firewall/network tweaks. Dependencies: KMS SDK support, cert provisioning, installer artifacts, e2e test harness for constrained networks.
Priya: Security checklist (initial): customer-managed HSM (FIPS 140-2 level 2+), no private key export, isolated control plane w/ limited management IPs, audit logs pushed to customer SIEM (syslog/CEF), require pen-test window and attestation. Need legal to confirm key-custody language.
Jordan: Quick note on ports/setup (draft):
```
- ingress: 443 (from customer mgmt IPs)
- internal: 10250 (kube), 9090 (metrics), 50051 (grpc)
- egress: restricted/none for inference pods
```
Not final, customer firewall will dictate specifics.
ops-bot: Ticket created IN-2026-4423: "AcmeCorp private VPC + HSM intake". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IN-2026-4423
Elaine: Draft launch criteria: - customer acceptance test on staging passed; - HSM integration validated (key rotation + no-export confirmed); - zero internet egress for inference lane; - audit log delivery validated; - deployment runbook + rollback verified; - contract signed and payment/committed capacity on file. Which of these are blockers?
Jordan: Blockers I see: PKCS#11 adapter stability (needs 1–2 validation cycles), automated deployment into constrained subnets (MTU, routes), and packaging for customer-controlled certs.
Priya: Blockers from security/legal: legal needs clear key custody wording and export controls; pen-test scheduling required before prod sign-off; must confirm retention/PII constraints.
Sam: I'll confirm contract signature ETA (end of week) and request the customer's infra contact + preferred pen-test windows. I'll also ask for their SOC2/ISO docs if available.
Elaine: Next steps and owners: Sam — confirm customer contact + contract status; Jordan — produce a rough project plan + sprint-level asks by Tue; Priya — list required compliance artifacts and pen-test checklist; Elaine — assemble intake doc and run a 30-min triage Wed 10am PT. Owners noted: Sam (sales), Jordan (eng-platform), Priya (security), Elaine (product).
Jordan: Acknowledged. I'll attach the proto project plan to IN-2026-4423 when ready.
Sam: 👍 will share contact and SOW in the ticket.
Elaine: Thanks all. Quick callout: 7 weeks is optimistic — call it "possible with prioritization" and we'll surface a realistic ETA on Tue after the project plan. If any urgent blockers pop up ping #eng-oncall.
